card.name: Patients after antidepressant-treated in warnings
card.fires_on: The word "patients" right after "antidepressant-treated" in the suicidality boxed warning ("Closely monitor all antidepressant-treated patients for clinical worsening"). It also fires on "patients" in the similar antiepileptic drug warning.

modes.label: Antidepressant monitoring warning
modes.description: "patients" completing "all antidepressant-treated" in the instruction to monitor for clinical worsening and suicidal thoughts.
modes.example: Closely monitor all antidepressant-treated<< patients>> for clinical worsening and emergence of suicidal thoughts

modes.label: Antiepileptic suicidality warning
modes.description: "patients" after "suicidal thoughts or behavior in" in the antiepileptic drug warning.
modes.example: increase the risk of suicidal thoughts or behavior in<< patients>> taking these drugs for any indication.

card.plain: It marks the word "patients" in the standard suicidality warning that tells prescribers to watch people on antidepressants.
